## berth env set

set a variable: the value is read hidden, or from stdin (restarts a running org)

### Synopsis

set a variable: the value is read hidden, or from stdin (restarts a running org)

Docs: https://ar4mirez.github.io/berth/reference/commands/berth_env_set/

```
berth env set <org> KEY [--no-restart] [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  berth env set acme OPENROUTER_API_KEY
  berth env set acme OPENROUTER_API_KEY --no-restart < key.txt
```

```
  -h, --help   help for set
```
